When she and her brother stopped at the theater, Mrs. Curry spotted her estranged husband sitting with her niece.

Five Knoxville persons, including Bob Suffridge, former Tennessee football player, have been indicted by a Federal grand jury for conspiracy against the Government, United States District Attorney John C. Crawford has revealed.
